coverage_gaps: HEADLINE GAP — POS floorplan dine-in feature ENTIRELY unaudited and itself an ungated dine-in surface. routes/api.php:918-922 expose POST floorplan/transfer, POST floorplan/{tableId}/assign, POST floorplan/{tableId}/release, GET floorplan/state, gated ONLY by middleware permission:pos (FloorplanController.php:16) with NO pos_dine_in_enabled check (grep dine_in in FloorplanController = 0). These mutate occupancy_status/occupied_order_id/occupied_at and sync orders.dining_table_id (DiningTableService::occupy). With dine-in OFF this is a larger server-authoritative dine-in gap than S17-01's QR path and is why S17-04 is false. S17 mandate is 'verify dine-in is gated'; auditor checked 3 order-entry surfaces and missed this whole table-management surface. Warrants its own P1/P2 finding.
OrderService.php:1295 tryReleaseTableAfterPosOrderPaid runs on every POS order paid regardless of dine-in flag — unaudited side-effect touching dining_tables occupancy on the normal POS cash flow.

FloorplanController assign/release/transfer write across DiningTable + Order via resolveOperatorContext (L69); multi-tenant correctness of orders.dining_table_id writes for the V2 two-branch case (the very risk S17-03 flags) was not examined.

Unauthenticated public reads GET table/dining-table/ index and table/item-category/ (api.php ~1508-1513) not exercised for cross-branch scope in V2; S17-03 covers model scope but not these index/category reads.
